steps: Get the story bible for project "The Seed Vault"

entries.name: Dr. Alani Reyes
entries.description: Sole guardian of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault. Former academic from UC Davis who has survived alone in the vault for 3 years, 4 months after nuclear war. Maintains strict daily routines and finds psychological comfort in audio logs from her deceased mentor Dr. Marcus Thorne. Appears to be of Hispanic heritage, originally from Stockton, California.

entries.name: Dr. Marcus Thorne
entries.description: Alani's former mentor and the original architect of the seed vault project. Died in the second wave of nuclear strikes while visiting his daughter in Chicago. Left behind 57 personal audio logs that serve as Alani's only human contact. Believed the vault was humanity's ark against catastrophe.

entries.name: Captain Eva Lindqvist
entries.description: Norwegian Special Forces officer who has somehow survived the nuclear winter and tracked down the seed vault. Pale, gaunt, equipped with military cold weather gear and weapons. Claims to represent surviving elements of the Norwegian government and says Alani is 'not alone anymore.'

entries.name: Svalbard Global Seed Vault - Post-War
entries.description: Located in the permafrost of Spitzbergen Island, 1,300km north of Arctic Circle. Consists of 130-meter entrance tunnel through solid rock leading to three main storage chambers containing thousands of seed samples. Currently maintained by Alani alone with supplies for 8 months to 2 years depending on item. External temperature minus 43°C, internal storage at minus 18°C.

entries.name: The Nuclear War
entries.description: Global nuclear conflict that ended civilization three years and four months ago, occurring on a Tuesday. Involved multiple waves of strikes - major population centers like Chicago were destroyed in the second wave. Created nuclear winter conditions with perpetual gray skies and no sunlight.

entries.name: The Arrival
entries.description: Captain Lindqvist's unexpected arrival at the vault after 1,237 days of Alani's complete isolation. She claims to represent surviving Norwegian forces and wants to discuss 'what comes next' regarding the seeds, suggesting organized survivors still exist.

entries.name: Series Bible
entries.description:
SYNOPSIS: Ten years after a engineered blight wiped out 90% of the world's crop species, a former agricultural geneticist and a hardened military escort must cross a collapsed continent to reach the Svalbard Global Seed Vault — the last known repository of viable pre-blight seeds — before a rival faction destroys it to consolidate control over the world's remaining food supply.
STORY ARC: The Threshold Journey: from the ruins of the old world to the last seed of the new
TARGET CHAPTER COUNT: 8
DRAMATIC QUESTION: Can geneticist Mara Voss and her military escort reach the Svalbard Seed Vault and open it to all factions before the Covenant destroys it to monopolize the world's food supply forever?

entries.name: Mara Voss
entries.description: Protagonist. Geneticist with ten years of experience navigating post-Collapse committees and rationing boards. Holds the master fragment of Dr. Halvorsen's secondary access key to the Vault. Carries a seed journal (surveyor's field book, 214 entries) cataloguing surviving wild plant varieties. Trusted by Ingrid Halvorsen specifically because she understands the cost of knowledge misused. Practical, controlled, keeps hands flat on tables to avoid looking like she is pleading. Hands shake only when alone.

entries.name: Councillor Vang
entries.description: NRA council member. Approximately sixty years old, weathered face. Speaks carefully and precisely. Knew Mara held the master fragment before Mara disclosed it. Delivered the warning that the Vault's cold storage may have failed. Sits to Brekke's left.

entries.name: Ingrid Halvorsen
entries.description: Deceased geneticist (Dr. Halvorsen). Designed the Vault's secondary access protocol and distributed key fragments to trusted individuals, giving Mara the master fragment. Last seen by Mara in a corridor in Bergen three months before her death. Told Mara she was the right person because she understood the cost of knowledge misused. Her encoded secondary manifest is the mission's primary objective.

entries.name: Daan Reyes
entries.description: Sergeant, formerly Norwegian Army Rangers, currently NRA authority. Assigned as Mara's sole escort to Svalbard. Ranger-qualified; last operation was a three-day protective supply corridor at Saltfjellet eighteen months ago with casualties. Moves with quiet economy. Carries a dry bag containing a friend's chess-game notebook. Secretly instructed by Strand to signal her before the secondary manifest access codes are used, under coercion involving his ward Sigrid's settlement placement on NRA supply priority lists.

entries.name: Councillor Lund
entries.description: NRA council member. Dry, careful voice; was a bureaucrat before the Collapse and continued afterward. Described the three-faction territorial situation and the Covenant's movements. Articulated the political objective of the manifest broadcast.

entries.name: Sigrid
entries.description: Eight-year-old girl living in the Hammerstad cluster settlement above the fjord, connected to Daan Reyes. Her settlement's placement on the NRA supply priority list is used by Strand as leverage over Daan. Represents the future generation the mission is meant to serve.

entries.name: Kemi
entries.description: Mara's original medic and former student. Memorised every entry in Mara's seed journal. Helped Mara excavate a surviving rye plant outside Bodø. Labelled all ration packs in blocky capitals. Reassigned the night before departure, officially redirected to Boström's unit responding to a Covenant column near Narvik.

entries.name: Northern Remnant Authority (NRA) settlement
entries.description: The base of operations for the mission. Location not precisely named but situated in northern Norway. Contains a briefing room, motor pool (former municipal bus depot), barracks, and eastern gate with a gravel departure apron. Authority spaces smell of tallow candles and damp wool.

entries.name: Hammerfest
entries.description: Coastal town where Covenant forward elements were confirmed eight days before the briefing, moving north toward the Vault.

entries.name: Pinzgauer
entries.description: Drab-green military utility vehicle assigned to the mission. Has a cargo rack welded on with poor but functional welds. Diesel engine. Used to transport the team north along the coastal route. Loaded with fuel cans, ration packs, and mission equipment.

entries.name: Councillor Brekke
entries.description: NRA council member. Broad man, formerly ran the Tromsø municipal water authority. Speaks in controlled, practical terms. Presents the political objective of broadcasting the Vault manifest to prevent monopoly control. Delivered the six-week window warning regarding the E6 corridor.

entries.name: Colonel Strand
entries.description: NRA officer with independent intelligence agenda. Instructed Daan to signal her before the manifest access codes are used, ostensibly to ensure the broadcast reaches all settlements simultaneously. Leverages Sigrid's settlement placement as implicit coercion. Prepared replacement personnel paperwork at 0340 hours, before the supposed Covenant emergency that justified swapping Mara's original team. Speaks without warmth or contempt; separates opinions from assessments.

entries.name: Eriksen
entries.description: Replacement team member, male. Broad-shouldered, dark-bearded. Carries a Sako pre-Collapse Finnish military rifle. Claims two seasons of winter operations in Finnmark. Substituted for original team member at 1800 hours the night before departure via paperwork prepared at 0340. First name not given.

entries.name: Boström
entries.description: Original team member, reassigned the night before departure along with Kemi, officially redirected to the Narvik corridor in response to a reported Covenant column.

entries.name: E6 corridor north of Alta
entries.description: Key northern supply and travel route. Impassable due to ice after a six-week window from the story's present. Loss of this corridor means no resupply or extraction is possible. Defines the mission's hard deadline.

entries.name: Hammerstad cluster
entries.description: Settlement above the fjord where Sigrid lives. Receives NRA supply runs from the Lofoten depot twice monthly. Strand controls its placement on the priority supply list, using this as leverage over Daan.

entries.name: Core sampler
entries.description: The heaviest item in Mara's pack at eighteen kilos total. A scientific instrument relevant to her work as a geneticist, carried on the mission.

entries.name: Lind
entries.description: Replacement team medic, female, mid-twenties. Medical kit strapped to thigh containing trauma supplies, antibiotics, suture kit, morphine, field dressings. Claims to have trained at Tromsø, but paused before answering, suggesting the answer may be false; Daan expected a different answer (Bodø). Substituted for Kemi at 1800 hours the night before departure.

entries.name: The Vault (Svalbard Global Seed Vault)
entries.description: Located in Svalbard. Stores 1.3 million seed samples including pre-blight wheat, rice, and bean varieties representing millennia of agricultural genetics, described as the only viable pre-blight agricultural genetics left in the world. Designed to maintain minus eighteen degrees Celsius. Backup power systems rated for fifteen years without resupply; the mission occurs at the ten-year mark, raising doubt about cold-chain integrity. Contains a secondary manifest encoded by Ingrid Halvorsen, accessible only via her distributed key fragments.

entries.name: Kautokeino
entries.description: Location where a previous NRA team was sent north; two members did not return before the team even reached it. Establishes the danger of the northern route.

entries.name: Saltfjellet
entries.description: Location of Daan's last Ranger operation eighteen months prior: a three-day protective supply corridor with casualties.

entries.name: The blight
entries.description: A catastrophic agricultural event that destroyed most viable crop genetics worldwide. Preceded the Collapse. The Vault was created as insurance against it; now the Vault holds the only known pre-blight agricultural genetics. Wild varieties in Mara's notebook have adapted since the blight and represent post-blight surviving biodiversity.

entries.name: The three-faction territorial division
entries.description: The NRA controls the coastal corridor to Alta. The Freehold controls the inland passes beyond Alta; not hostile to the NRA but not friendly, with its own interest in the Vault. The Covenant is an antagonist faction whose forward elements were at Hammerfest and moving north; expected to seal the Vault and monopolise seed access if they reach it first.

entries.name: Svalbard setting
entries.description:
- **Svalbard setting**: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is on the Norwegian island of *Spitsbergen* in the Arctic Svalbard archipelago, about 1,300 kilometers beyond the Arctic Circle.[2][5] It is built into permafrost and rock, with the entrance leading through a roughly 100-meter tunnel into underground storage caverns.[4][5]

- **What the Vault is for**: It is a backup facility that stores **duplicate seed samples** from genebanks around the world, so collections can be restored if national or

entries.name: The Collapse
entries.description: A societal breakdown that occurred approximately ten years before the story's present. Ended centralised infrastructure, heating, supply chains, and governance. Replaced by faction-controlled territories. Referenced as the dividing line between the old world and the current one.

entries.name: The six-week winter window
entries.description: The operational deadline for the mission. After six weeks, ice closes the E6 corridor north of Alta, making resupply and extraction impossible. Both the NRA and the Covenant are racing against this window.

entries.name: The secondary manifest
entries.description: A complete index of the Vault's contents by depositor and sample code, encoded by Ingrid Halvorsen and accessible only via her distributed key fragments. Broadcasting it to all settlements is the mission's political objective: making the seeds a common resource no faction can monopolise. Strand wants to control the timing of its release.
